description: Embed trusted expert insights directly into your research and decision making workflows in real-time. Powered by Guidepoint's in-house team of former investment analysts, we combine institutional-grade quality with the volume needed for decision-critical work. Claude pulls verbatim excerpts from 100,000+ compliance-reviewed expert interview transcripts — with every source transcript linked inline for verifiable, trusted data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Guidepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Guidepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://clapi.guidepoint.io/mcp-server/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Guidepoint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guidepoint provides these MCP tools: search_library.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Guidepoint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Guidepoint in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Guidepoint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Guidepoint is developed by Guidepoint. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
